description: Golden decode vectors for Dex client-side payload encryption, format dex/1. Every SDK must decode each positive case to expectedPlaintext and expectedValue, return each passthrough input unchanged, and reject each negative case with expectedError. See protos/payload-encryption.md.

passthrough.name: plaintext-string
passthrough.description: A string Value is not an envelope.

passthrough.name: plaintext-json-object
passthrough.description: An object with encoding json is not an envelope.

passthrough.name: plaintext-int
passthrough.description: An int Value is not an envelope.

passthrough.name: object-encoding-dex-without-slash
passthrough.description: Only encodings starting with dex/ are reserved; dex is an ordinary encoding.

passthrough.name: text-plain
passthrough.description: Text without the prefix is plaintext.

passthrough.name: text-space-escaped-prefix
passthrough.description: A writer without a codec prepends one space to plaintext that starts with dex-encoded:. The prefix must start at the first byte, so readers show this text unchanged, space included.

positive.name: string-ascii
positive.description: A string Value.

positive.name: string-unicode
positive.description: A string Value with multi-byte UTF-8.

positive.name: string-empty
positive.description: An empty string is still serialized because Value.kind is a oneof.

positive.name: object-json
positive.description: An object with encoding json.

positive.name: object-raw
positive.description: An object with encoding raw and arbitrary bytes.

positive.name: object-encoding-int
positive.description: An object whose encoding is the text int must decode as obj_value, not int_value.

positive.name: int-positive
positive.description: An int Value.

positive.name: int-zero
positive.description: Zero is still serialized because Value.kind is a oneof.

positive.name: int-negative
positive.description: A negative int uses a 10-byte varint.

positive.name: int-max
positive.description: The largest int64.

positive.name: int-min
positive.description: The smallest int64.

positive.name: double-positive
positive.description: A double Value.

positive.name: double-negative
positive.description: A negative double.

positive.name: double-negative-zero
positive.description: Negative zero keeps its sign bit; compare bits, not ==.

positive.name: double-nan
positive.description: NaN with bits 0x7ff8000000000000; compare with an is-NaN check, not bits or ==.

positive.name: double-positive-infinity
positive.description: Positive infinity.

positive.name: bool-true
positive.description: A bool Value.

positive.name: bool-false
positive.description: False is still serialized because Value.kind is a oneof.

positive.name: string-gzip
positive.description: A string compressed with gzip before encryption.

negative.name: wrong-tag
negative.description: The last tag byte is flipped.

negative.name: truncated-data-one-byte
negative.description: The last byte of data is removed.

negative.name: truncated-data-below-minimum
negative.description: data is shorter than nonce plus tag (28 bytes).

negative.name: unknown-key-id
negative.description: key_id k9 is not in the key file; the tag is valid for k1 bytes.

negative.name: unspecified-cipher
negative.description: cipher is PAYLOAD_CIPHER_UNSPECIFIED (0), authenticated as 0.

negative.name: unknown-cipher
negative.description: cipher is the unknown value 7, authenticated as 7.

negative.name: custom-cipher-without-custom-codec
negative.description: PAYLOAD_CIPHER_CUSTOM reaches the built-in AES-GCM codec.

negative.name: unknown-compression
negative.description: compression is the unknown value 9, authenticated as 9.

negative.name: unknown-marker-version
negative.description: The encoding is dex/2; the payload is a valid dex/1 envelope.

negative.name: metadata-total-too-large
negative.description: metadata keys and values total maxMetadataTotalBytes + 1 bytes.
negative.checkOrder: Also uses PAYLOAD_CIPHER_CUSTOM, which the built-in codec rejects; the metadata limit check runs first. No single-rule form exists for the built-in codec, because any metadata breaks its empty-metadata rule.

negative.name: metadata-too-many-entries
negative.description: metadata holds maxMetadataEntries + 1 entries.
negative.checkOrder: Also uses PAYLOAD_CIPHER_CUSTOM, which the built-in codec rejects; the metadata limit check runs first. No single-rule form exists for the built-in codec, because any metadata breaks its empty-metadata rule.

negative.name: metadata-with-builtin-cipher
negative.description: PAYLOAD_CIPHER_AES256_GCM requires empty metadata.

negative.name: aad-mismatch-key-id
negative.description: key_id was changed from k1 to k1-alias, which has the same key bytes.

negative.name: aad-mismatch-compression
negative.description: Encrypted without compression, then relabeled as gzip.

negative.name: corrupt-gzip
negative.description: compression is gzip but the authenticated plaintext is not gzip data.

negative.name: envelope-not-protobuf
negative.description: The payload is not a valid PayloadEnvelope encoding.

negative.name: empty-payload
negative.description: An empty payload is an envelope with an empty key_id.
negative.checkOrder: Also has cipher 0 and no data; the key_id check runs first. empty-key-id covers the key_id rule alone.

negative.name: empty-key-id
negative.description: key_id is empty.

negative.name: key-id-too-long
negative.description: key_id has 65 bytes.

negative.name: key-id-with-space
negative.description: key_id contains a space, which is outside 0x21 to 0x7e.

negative.name: plaintext-null-value
negative.description: The authenticated plaintext is a null Value, which is never encrypted.

negative.name: plaintext-blob-reference
negative.description: The authenticated plaintext is a blob reference, which is never encrypted.

negative.name: plaintext-nested-envelope
negative.description: The authenticated plaintext is itself a dex/1 object; envelopes do not nest.

negative.name: plaintext-not-a-value
negative.description: The authenticated plaintext is not a valid Value encoding.

negative.name: text-plaintext-not-string
negative.description: Prefix-format text whose authenticated plaintext is an int Value.

negative.name: text-invalid-base64
negative.description: The text after the prefix is not base64.

negative.name: text-unpadded-base64
negative.description: The base64 after the prefix omits its padding.

negative.name: limit-envelope-over-maximum
negative.description: The object payload is maxEnvelopeBytes + 1 long.

negative.name: limit-encoded-text-over-maximum
negative.description: The base64 after the prefix is maxEncodedTextBytes + 1 long.

negative.name: limit-data-over-maximum
negative.description: data is maxDataBytes + 1 long.

negative.name: limit-plaintext-over-maximum
negative.description: The decrypted plaintext is maxPlaintextBytes + 1 long.

negative.name: limit-decompressed-plaintext-over-maximum
negative.description: The decompressed plaintext is maxPlaintextBytes + 1 long.

negative.name: limit-envelope-checked-before-parsing
negative.description: An over-limit payload that is not protobuf.
negative.checkOrder: Also not protobuf; the payload length check runs before parsing.

negative.name: limit-encoded-text-checked-before-base64
negative.description: Over-limit text after the prefix that is not base64.
negative.checkOrder: Also not base64; the text length check runs before base64 decoding.

negative.name: limit-data-checked-before-decryption
negative.description: Over-limit data whose tag is also wrong.
negative.checkOrder: Also has a wrong tag; the data length check runs before decryption.
